title: Does collagen actually do anything? 🦴
caption:
For building muscle, collagen is a poor protein: low in leucine and missing an essential amino acid. For tendons, small early studies with vitamin C look interesting but are far from proven. Do you take collagen? 👇

General information, not medical advice.
